org.name: LAB Music Management
org.description: Music management company. This web-extractor pulls live web data relevant to artist roster, releases, touring, streaming, press and bookings.

//: Each target is one adjustable extraction recipe. Add/edit freely — code is generic and reads from here. 'engine' is one of: search | fetch | agent | browser.

targets.label: Artist press & mentions
targets.query: {{artist}} music news OR interview OR review

targets.label: Streaming / playlist placements
targets.goal: Find this artist's profile, monthly listeners, top tracks and any editorial playlist placements. Return JSON with fields: artist, monthlyListeners, topTracks[], playlists[].

targets.label: Tour & event listings
targets.goal: List all upcoming events for this artist. Return JSON array with fields: date, venue, city, country, ticketUrl.

targets.label: Clean a specific URL to markdown/JSON

//variables: Default values for {{placeholders}} above. Override per-run via CLI flags or the API request body.
